title: 150 lots, 11 years, RM44 million: investment or trade? (Ismail bin Idris v KPHDN)
summary: The Penang High Court agreed with LHDN that a RM44 million sale of 150 land lots held for 11 years was business income, not a capital gain. Holding land for a long time did not settle it.

title: The RM2,000 rule: small value assets, explained with a restaurant (Public Ruling No. 4/2026)
summary: LHDN's updated public ruling on small value assets, published 30 September 2026. Items up to RM2,000 each can get a 100% special allowance; SMEs have no annual cap, other companies and LLPs are capped at RM20,000.
